data: What is the value of the blue circle at 60% of reviews in the top graph?

The question asks for the value of the blue circle at 60% of reviews in the top graph. The top graph shows two lines representing BLEU4 scores for Clothing and Cell Phones. The blue circles represent the BLEU4 score for Clothing. At 60% of reviews, the blue circle is located at approximately 0.16 on the y-axis. Therefore, the value of the blue circle at 60% of reviews is around 0.16.
